system.description: Touching a communication device and spending a Willpower Trait projects your consciousness into the global telecommunications network, letting you apply any Path of Technomancy power to devices you encounter there. The effect lasts 10 minutes plus five minutes per level of Computer Ability, extendable by 10 more minutes per additional Willpower Trait spent, with a default range of 25 miles extendable by spending Mental Traits. If disconnected, you are yanked back to your body and suffer five levels of unhalved bashing damage.
